risks.detail: Migration, pure command and store tests prove the single retail row advances through active generation 1, transitional generation 2 and active generation 3; rollback emits no pointer DELETE and first-insert races become stale CAS.
Local tests prove browse carries one internal binding into resolver-context projection, and active Authority/Resolve/Profile use immutable release IDs from the validated Manifest.
Missing or invalid active pointer, Manifest or release binding raises before staging reads; only zero-row pre-cutover and explicit transitional state enter compatibility readers.
Candidate rehearsal must prove promote, rollback and re-promotion with backups and exact pointer generations before merge.
No scheduled refresh, automatic promotion, Phase 5 work or Catalyst activation is in scope.

summary: Slice 4D is implementation-allowed only for atomic formal Manifest cutover, release-scoped public readers, monotonic pointer rollback/re-promotion and truthful health/admin evidence. Scheduled refresh, Phase 5 and Catalyst remain excluded.
